name: Naija Life: Lagos Simulator
summary: Naija Life: Lagos Simulator is a free-to-play 3D life simulation game set in Nigeria. Players create a Sim and live in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt or any of 37 cities, one for each Nigerian state and the Federal Capital Territory, each with its own landmark, jobs, homes and festival. The Sim has six needs that fall over time. Money comes from 61 careers with five levels each, side hustles, daily contests or a player-run business. Players can rent or buy homes, or buy land and build a house to live in, let or sell. Other features include marriage, children, adoption, pets, danfo and okada rides, and city elections that change fares, pay and prices. A Games app offers Ludo, Whot, Chess, Ayo, Draughts and other board and card games played live against other players. The game runs in a web browser and on Android and iOS, with one account and save across platforms.
